body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Kodak expanded its line of video cameras with the new digital video camera 'Kodak Zx1' at 2009 CES, which is a compact and weather-resistant device.

The Zx1 allows users to shoot and share high-quality video quickly and simply, with 720p HD video capture at 60 or 30 fps. Adopting a vibrant 2-inch LCD screen, it has built-in software for easy editing and sharing of content to YouTube and other social media and networking websites.
